capabilities: Pin bookmarks to a top row
Open bookmarks in the Web Viewer
extras: Meant to pair with Obsidian's Web Viewer core plugin; when that plugin is off, unavailable, or on mobile, bookmarks open in the system browser instead. Arc import reads Arc's local data file directly and skips Arc's unpinned tabs by design.
intentEvidence: This plugin is the bookmarks manager to go with it
motivation: To provide the bookmarks manager Obsidian's Web Viewer lacks: a persistent sidebar that stays visible while browsing, rather than a bookmarks-and-browser hybrid that disappears when you click a link.
problem: Obsidian's Web Viewer can read links but ships no bookmarks manager, so saved sites can't be organized or reopened inside the app.
